text:
Mira Patel: dropping a compact thread  new idea: a tiny inline 'badge' after label that says 'Required' (caps, pill) but only visible on hover/focus. goal: clear semantics without heavy asterisks. mock: https://figma.redwood/company/req-badge

Priya Desai: I like the explicit word vs symbol. question: in mobile/responsive views hover doesn't exist. what shows on small screens?

Liza Chen: mobile suggestion: always show the badge for mobile but reduce prominence (outline only). keep desktop subtle (hover reveals fill). avoids discoverability issues on touch.

Alex Morgan: dev note: if we show badge text visually, ensure inputs still carry aria-required and aria-labels aren't duplicated. for inline errors, validate on blur for non-empty and show top summary only after submit. also consider animation (fade-in) for error messages to avoid layout shift.

Kevin Liu: accessibility: use aria-required=true and aria-describedby linking to error text. for mobile where badge is always visible, avoid redundancy by not repeating the same phrase in aria-live. for modals/typed-confirm: use clear instruction "Type the workspace name to confirm deletion". reserve typed-confirm for org-level deletes; for bulk deletes use checkbox + modal. restore focus after close and announce the modal with role=dialog and aria-modal=true.

Mira Patel: copy nit: badge copy should be just "Required" not "*Required". for danger flows, prefer contextual resource name in instruction instead of generic DELETE. also propose an undo toast for soft-deletes (8s).

Priya Desai: UX nit: when showing both a summary and inline, make the summary link jump and expose which field is failing with a short anchor label (e.g., "Name missing"), avoid reading duplicates to SRs.

Liza Chen: metric ask: track form completion time and error rate for first-time users during A/B of badge vs asterisk.

design-bot: reminder: add this thread to Thu review agenda. :spiral_calendar:

Mira Patel: noted  I'll post updated frames for mobile+desktop by Tue EOD. thanks all.
